name: Belagam Agraharam
pros: Highest score; on the edge of Parvathipuram town, 0.8 km from Parvatipuram station; flat (1.4°); school and health facility within ~300 m
cons: Andhra Pradesh jurisdiction (Meebhoomi records, AP land rules, partly Scheduled district); peri-urban asking prices; already 27% built-up, so open infill land is limited

name: Sai Priya Nagar
pros: Rayagada district HQ edge; station 1.4 km; flattest zone (0.9°); deepest rental and services market in the circle
cons: Town-level plot prices; longest drive from Nilabadi of the top three (≈50 km, ≈57 min); check municipal / development-authority layout approval

name: Beheraguda
pros: On a major road (0.2 km), 5 km from Rayagada; Ladda station 2.4 km; mostly cropland so low clearing cost
cons: Nagavali river runs ~1–2 km east (see thumbnail): confirm high-flood level on site; farmland usually needs kisam conversion before building

name: Gangareguvalasa
pros: Major road 0.2 km; Gumada station 3.9 km; gentle slope (1.8°); between Parvathipuram and the Odisha border
cons: Andhra Pradesh jurisdiction; 8 km to Parvathipuram; 35% tree cover in the zone

name: Sivandravalasa
pros: Shortest drive from Nilabadi of the AP zones (≈28.5 km, ≈32 min); 75% open cropland
cons: Andhra Pradesh jurisdiction; mostly agricultural land (conversion needed); 6 km to a major town

name: Amalabhata
pros: Near the JK Paper complex at Jaykaypur (industrial jobs = rental demand); major road 0.1 km; Singapur Road Jn station 3 km
cons: Check industrial air, water and truck traffic; ≈57 km / ≈61 min drive from Nilabadi

name: Putturu
pros: Largest contiguous high-score zone (≈464 ha); major road 0.2 km; flat cropland
cons: Andhra Pradesh jurisdiction; 8.6 km to a major town; farmland conversion needed

name: Kuli
pros: 80% cropland, 7 km from Rayagada; major road 0.3 km
cons: Small zone; longest drive from Nilabadi (≈67 km, ≈71 min) because the road network goes round the hills

name: Kandhajimidi
pros: Jimidipeta station 0.1 km; closest Rayagada-side zone to Nilabadi in straight line (18.6 km)
cons: Slow roads (≈42 km, ≈64 min drive); 14 km to a major town; small zone (≈36 ha)

name: Lakshmipur
pros: Lakshmipur block HQ 0.6 km; Lakshmipur Road station 1.6 km; closest zone to Nilabadi (17 km W)
cons: Far from any large town (≈38 km); steeper (3.5°); small zone (≈31 ha)

name: Nilabadi (village centroid, benchmark)
pros: Block HQ (Bandhugaon) ~2 km W; village services
cons: Hilly mixed cover; 2.4 km to a major road; 17.6 km to a station; thin rental demand
